Question: I am 33yrs mother of 3 children my husband Alhumdolillaah loves me alot but since 2 yrs im going through depression as the days are passing by 1)earlier days i used to bring my children from school but now i feel afraid to step out of the house that i will faint (2)from inside i feel week,suddenly my heart beats slow my legs/hands shivers feels acidity &sometimes sweat but all the test eg;ct scan,braineeg,ecg,ecocardiograpy all are normal.so kindly let me know some dua to heal this dieses im pray regularly. Answer ID: 6951 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1748=H/1429) After every obligatory salah, before going to bed and after waking up, Recite Surah Quraish (No. 106) with durood eleven times before and after and blow on hands and pass on the hands over the body. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
